note: 發音改為單字一次，再接一個包含該字的簡單詞彙；AI 與備用模板共用發音規則。送出時保存完整版本。
constraints: Exactly 8 seconds long, single continuous shot.

Keep the teaching object and its transforming shape centered and uncropped throughout. Once formed, the single Traditional Chinese character occupies approximately 70% of the frame height with clear margins on all sides.
3D Pixar / Disney toy render style. Vivid high-contrast colors, warm playful palette, soft studio lighting, glossy chunky toy materials.
Background is an extremely clean, minimal, solid light-colored backdrop. Only the teaching objects specified in the beats are allowed. No scenery or unrelated props.

Follow the timing of the three BEAT instructions exactly. Each object part should visibly become a specific stroke; the final glyph has crisp, separated strokes and correct Traditional Chinese structure.
Camera is locked off, or at most a very slow gentle push-in. No whip pans, no orbits, no shake.

NEGATIVE: no background story, no unrelated people or passersby, no flickering particles, no harsh sparkles, no lens flare, no motion blur on the glyph, no simplified Chinese, no extra text, letters, numbers, or watermarks. A toy figure is allowed only if explicitly required as the teaching object.
audio: Audio: a warm, friendly, child-directed adult voice speaks in clear Taiwanese Mandarin. First pronounce the target character "{char}" once, pause briefly, then say ONE simple everyday word containing that exact character once. Choose a familiar, concrete word suitable for a 6-year-old, preferably two characters, using the same reading and meaning of the target as taught in this clip. For example, for 木 the entire spoken line is "木……木頭". Do not repeatedly chant the isolated character or repeat the whole line. Include the exact chosen spoken line in Traditional Chinese in the video prompt, not just an instruction to choose a word. Fit both utterances naturally within the 8 seconds without rushing, preferably while the finished glyph is clearly visible. The vocabulary word is audio only: keep only the single target glyph on screen, with no vocabulary text or subtitles. No extra spoken explanation, English translation, or background music louder than the voice.

styleRules.text: The character's strokes are a saturated solid color against a much lighter background - maximum readability for a young child.
styleRules.reason: 預設：字要看得清楚是這個專案的第一目標

styleRules.text: The final centered hold must last at least 3 full seconds so a child has time to recognise the shape.
styleRules.reason: 預設：6 歲需要辨識時間

styleRules.text: Bright but not neon. Avoid pure white blowouts and avoid dark or moody grading.
